component: Flow selected control/edit grips, shared staged mixed edits and immutable previews
implementation: Accept active control/edit grip IDs in Flow, use the existing grip reconstruction/copy/group/history paths, and supply precomputed ordinary object geometry to a shared staged document edit. Each grip follows the point map regardless of Rigid. Ordinary rigid peers use group bounds including grip owners. Copies of grip owners join their source groups. The shared display cages preview the same source basis and group poses without document mutation.

native_capture.method: Owned private display and public RhinoCommon geometry, command and EndCommand APIs. Run the worker at Rhino idle outside the RunPythonScript undo record. Record before, EndCommand, completed macro, Undo and Redo separately. Compare completed macro state after temporary guide and postselection cleanup. No trailing Cancel tokens. Undo must actually change owner outputs, not merely return a successful macro status.
native_capture.capture_note: Earlier discovery probes inside the script undo record or with trailing Cancel were rejected for history qualification. The retained capture contains the successful complete macros and real history transitions.

families: rational NURBS curve Greville edit grips
checks: complete owner control nets/knots/weights/degrees or mesh vertices/faces/normals
active grip modes and selected grip positions/indices
group memberships and counts, original/copy identity, ordinary point peers
Undo/Redo geometry, group and grip selection states
local staged failures retain geometry, selection, history and redo
interactive preselection and command-first grip getters, Copy, Rigid and one-step Undo
shared read-only previews across all four families and rigid ordinary peers
existing 76 point maps and 43 whole point-cloud commands
existing 30 OrientOnSrf grip cases after reusing its snapshot helper

limitations: General spatial curved guides, Line, Local, Roadlike/Stairlike and TargetSurface remain Flow implementation work.
General fitted owner geometry, planar NURBS/closed guides, periodic/seam/alias native grip cases and additional group graphs need further native qualification.
No native preview-appearance or performance parity is claimed. No full workspace-suite claim.
